theme: An open calendar with a few bookings on the clock.
greeting: The girls are with Jen this week, Dan, so the day is yours after a single nine o'clock. The travel bookings are the one thing carrying a real deadline — the December trip needs to be booked by Thursday.

needsAttention.title: Lock the December break destination
needsAttention.detail: The book-by date is Thursday and the Sept 30 decision never landed. Holiday inventory for six over three weeks is the thinnest of the year, so a domestic shortlist is the safe default given passports won't be in hand when you book.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: The p1 on your board, overdue since Sept 14. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market — hold a refundable booking now before the holiday inventory sells out.

needsAttention.title: OECD November meeting invite
needsAttention.detail: A longtime governance contact wrote today asking you to the OECD corporate-governance meeting in November and to help line a few things up. A good door to answer while you're between roles.

schedule.title: Dr. Snowden
schedule.detail: One-hour appointment, the only thing on the calendar today

flagged.title: Eugenia wants to find a time
flagged.detail: She's back from Morocco Oct 31 and asked you to put a slot on the calendar — she also picked up on ICGN in Toronto. The ball's in your court on a date.

flagged.title: Morgan Stanley account funding
flagged.detail: A 'final reminder' to fund your new Signature Savings account. Worth a look to confirm it's genuine before the funding window closes.

flagged.title: Mom's care-plan paperwork
flagged.detail: Tampa Gardens still hasn't replied to your Oct 7 note about the updated plan of care — a phone nudge may move it faster than email.

inbox.noise: The rest is quiet — a LinkedIn role alert and a couple of seasonal retail promos.

resolved.title: Vinalhaven ferry tickets booked
resolved.detail: Confirmation came in Oct 12 and you've forwarded it to Mike — that one's closed.

recipe.title: Grilled quail with braised chestnuts & kabocha squash
recipe.why: Chestnuts and winter squash are at their autumn peak right now.

tasks.title: Drive the Pathfinder south, Portland to St Pete
Portland house order — bedframe + outdoor shower soap holder

acts.line: A nine o'clock with Dr. Snowden, and then the morning opens up.
Nothing on the calendar past ten — the afternoon runs clear.
A quiet evening, the girls down in Florida with Jen this week.
